text:
sarah-support: Customer (AcmePay) opened a ticket — production API started returning garbled chat responses this morning and their invoices spiked.

jordan-csm: they say it happened around 08:42 UTC, high QPS from EU cluster, complaining about truncated replies and wrong language tokens.

sarah-support: here's a sample payload they sent (sanitized):
```json
{"model":"redwood-chat-v2","input":"Summarize payment exceptions from last 24h"}
```
Response looked like: `Ĝ�Summarize: 交易错误...` (mix of bytes + chinese tokens)

sanjay-ml: that looks like tokenizer mismatch. Can you confirm the model actually served? Ask for the x-served-model header and request id.

sarah-support: just got the request headers from AcmePay logs: `x-region: eu-north-1`, `x-served-model: redwood-chat-v1-quant-lite`, `x-request-id: r-8f2a7c`

elaine-engops: whoa they requested v2 but got v1-quant-lite. That explains capability drop + tokenization differences. Why did routing choose the lite variant? Check routing logs for that timeframe.

deploy-bot: deploy event at 08:30 UTC: canary rollout for redwood-chat-v2 to eu-north-1. 08:35 UTC autoscaler evicted some v2 replicas for maintenance. Fallback policy: route -> compatible-standby (policy id: route-fallback-compat-1).

oncall-ml: fallback policy should prefer quantized-compatible variants with identical tokenizer. Looks like the standby had a different tokenizer/merge config. I’ll pull the standby model metadata.

sanjay-ml: also seeing elevated 401 spikes reported by billing system for that tenant around same time — could be retries inflating invoices. billing-bot, any correlating info?

billing-bot: billing reports show a 3x token billing increase between 08:40–09:10 UTC for AcmePay. Many requests retried with 502 then succeeded, token counts doubled due to client retry logic.

jordan-csm: client-side retries were aggressive (3 retries) because they saw intermittent 502s and 401s. They shared a small trace with `r-8f2a7c` and `r-8f2b1d`.

sarah-support: reproduced quickly with a curl showing header spoofing region:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "x-region: eu-north-1" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-v2","input":"test"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
Response headers: `x-served-model: redwood-chat-v1-quant-lite`, `x-model-tokenizer: bpe-v1`
Response body: `�test...` (garbled)

sanjay-ml: reproduction confirms silent swap. Root cause hypothesis: autoscaler depleted v2 replicas -> smart routing fell back to a standby group that was tagged compatible by architecture but actually had a different tokenizer version. We probably have a metadata mismatch in the model catalog tag (compatibility:true even with tokenizer delta).

elaine-engops: I found the catalog entry for `redwood-chat-v1-quant-lite` has `compatibility_tags: [chat-v2-compatible]` but tokenizer_version: `bpe-v1` while redwood-chat-v2 uses `bpe-v2` (merge rules changed). Bad tagging during onboarding.

oncall-ml: mitigation options: 1) Pin AcmePay to region eu-north-1 -> not ideal; 2) Add an override routing rule to avoid quantized-lite variants for chat-v2 until we reconcile tokenizers; 3) Roll back canary to avoid autoscaler thrash.

sarah-support: AcmePay is asking for compensation for billing spike + request for a stopgap to avoid more bad responses. They want repro steps so they can validate remediation.

jordan-csm: proposed immediate action: put a routing guard that requires tokenizer_version equality for fallback matches. That should prevent mismatched swaps. Can we patch quickly?

sanjay-ml: I can push a hotfix to routing policy to check `tokenizer_version` equality for fallback selection. Will require a short deploy to control plane (ETA 30m). After deploy, we should reprocess backlog tokens and offer a one-time credit for the doubled tokens.

elaine-engops: also recommend adding a short-term admission control: if served-model != requested-major-version then return 409 or degrade gracefully with explicit header and not silently swap. That avoids silent capability crashes.

billing-bot: created billing ticket BT-4421 for one-time credit proposal. Current estimate ~ 42k tokens to refund (prelim). Please confirm when we can mark for customer credit.

sarah-support: I told AcmePay we will (a) stop silent fallbacks to mismatched-tokenizer variants, (b) roll routing hotfix in ~30m, (c) offer credit and manual review of affected requests. They acknowledged and asked for a simple repro they can run after the fix.

sanjay-ml: repro steps to send to customer: 1) send request for redwood-chat-v2 with header `x-region: eu-north-1` during a simulated v2 depletion 2) confirm `x-served-model` equals `redwood-chat-v1-quant-lite` (pre-fix) 3) after patch, ensure response returns 409 with body explaining incompatible fallback or a `x-fallback-blocked: true` header. Provide a small script: 
```bash
# pre-fix check
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "x-region: eu-north-1" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-v2","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

sarah-support: sending those steps and ETA 30m to AcmePay now. Marking incident P2.

deploy-bot: routing hotfix deployed to control plane at 09:05 UTC, rollout 100% by 09:12 UTC.

oncall-ml: monitoring: sampling requests for AcmePay from 09:12–09:30 shows no silent swaps. `x-served-model` matches requested major version, tokenizer headers align. No further 401/502 spikes.

billing-bot: billing hold applied at 09:20 UTC pending credit review, holding additional chargebacks. Ticket BT-4421 updated.

jordan-csm: AcmePay ran repro after 09:15 and confirmed they now get a clear 409 when incompatible fallback would have occurred, and the client can choose to retry or route to a different region. They appreciated the transparency :white_check_mark:

sarah-support: summary/action items: 1) sanjay to push routing compatibility guard PR (merged) 2) ops to add regression test ensuring tokenizer_version parity across fallback paths 3) billing to finalize credit 4) customer notified with repro and resolution.

sanjay-ml: PR merged, will follow up tomorrow with a catalog audit job to detect mismatched tokenizer tags.

elaine-engops: I'll open an infra ticket to add the admission control error (409) and telemetry to make mismatches an explicit metric.

jordan-csm: closing loop with customer later today once credit finalized. Thanks team :pray:

billing-bot: billing ticket BT-4421 -> assigned to @billing-team.

sarah-support: closing thread, will reopen if any regression.
